description:
# Baseball Savant Leaderboards (2024-2026)

20 Baseball Savant leaderboards for the **2024, 2025 and 2026 MLB regular seasons**, one CSV per leaderboard with a `year` (or `season`) column, collected with [savant-extras](https://pypi.org/project/savant-extras/) **0.6.0**. The 2026 regular season ended on 2026-09-27 and is complete here.

Most of these leaderboards have no bulk download on Baseball Savant: the site serves one season (and often one pitch type or one position) per request. Here they are side by side across three seasons, keyed by the MLBAM player id where Savant provides one, so they join to Statcast pitch data and to each other.

## Files (20 CSVs)

| File | Category | Rows (2024 / 2025 / 2026) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bat_tracking.csv` | Batting | {rows:bat_tracking} | Bat speed, attack angle, swing tilt, attack direction (min 100 competitive swings, regular season dates from MLB StatsAPI) |
| `batted_ball.csv` | Batting | {rows:batted_ball} | GB/FB/LD/PU rates, pull/straight/oppo splits (qualified) |
| `home_runs.csv` | Batting | {rows:home_runs} | HR totals, park-adjusted xHR, no-doubters, mostly-gone, trot time. **Includes postseason home runs** (Savant's leaderboard has no filter): 2024 and 2025 with the postseason, 2026 regular season only |
| `swing_take.csv` | Batting | {rows:swing_take} | Swing/take run value by zone (Heart/Shadow/Chase/Waste); Savant's default list, the 300 batters who saw the most pitches |
| `year_to_year.csv` | Batting | {rows:year_to_year} | xwOBA for every season 2015-2026 with year-over-year deltas; `year` is the season whose qualified batters are listed (Savant lists no one for 2026 yet, but every row has the 2026 column) |
| `pitch_tempo.csv` | Pitching | {rows:pitch_tempo} | Median seconds between pitches, bases empty and runners on |
| `pitch_movement.csv` | Pitching | {rows:pitch_movement} | Horizontal and vertical break against league average, **every pitch type** (one request per pitch type and season) |
| `pitcher_arm_angle.csv` | Pitching | {rows:pitcher_arm_angle} | Arm angle and release/shoulder position |
| `running_game.csv` | Pitching | {rows:running_game} | Pitcher control of the running game: runs prevented, leads allowed, pickoffs |
| `timer_infractions.csv` | Pitching | {rows:timer_infractions} | Pitch clock violations by team and type |
| `pitcher_quality.csv` | Pitching | {rows:pitcher_quality} | Stuff+, Location+, Pitching+ (FanGraphs, 2024-2025 only) |
| `arm_strength.csv` | Fielding | {rows:arm_strength} | Fielder throw speed by position |
| `outs_above_average.csv` | Fielding | {rows:outs_above_average} | OAA and fielding runs prevented (qualified fielders) |
| `outfield_jump.csv` | Fielding | {rows:outfield_jump} | Outfielder reaction, burst and route vs league average (qualified) |
| `catcher_blocking.csv` | Catching | {rows:catcher_blocking} | Blocks above average, passed balls and wild pitches vs expected |
| `catcher_throwing.csv` | Catching | {rows:catcher_throwing} | Pop time, exchange, arm strength, caught stealing above average |
| `catcher_stance.csv` | Catching | {rows:catcher_stance} | One-knee vs traditional stance and its framing/blocking/throwing run value, one row per catcher |
| `baserunning.csv` | Baserunning | {rows:baserunning} | Baserunning run value (extra bases taken and stolen bases) |
| `basestealing.csv` | Baserunning | {rows:basestealing} | Stolen base run value, lead distances |
| `park_factors.csv` | Park | {rows:park_factors} | Statcast park factors by club (100 = neutral): runs over 1-year and 3-year windows; HR, 1B/2B/3B, SO, BB, wOBA, xwOBAcon and hard-hit over the 3-year window. Empty 3-year values for the Athletics' Sutter Health Park (2025, 2026), which has no 3-year history |

## What changed in this version (September 2026)

- **2026 added** to every table except `pitcher_quality` (FanGraphs does not serve the build machine) and `year_to_year` (see the table).
- File names no longer carry the years (`bat_tracking_2024_2025.csv` is now `bat_tracking.csv`).
- `park_factors` now comes from Baseball Savant instead of FanGraphs. The columns differ: `pf_5yr` and `pf_fip` are gone, and `pf_1yr` / `pf_3yr` keep FanGraphs-like names but are Savant's (Statcast) factors. `outfield_jump` now comes straight from Savant's CSV endpoint. Both now cover 2026.
- The column-description helper scripts (`col_*.js`) and `file_descriptions.txt` that were shipped by mistake are removed.

The version before the previous one had errors, all caused by Baseball Savant answering a request it does not understand with **the current season**: seven tables had the same table under 2024 and 2025, `swing_take` was empty, `catcher_stance` had league-level rows, `pitch_movement` had four-seam fastballs only and `outs_above_average` had no year. savant-extras 0.6.0 fixes these and checks the season it gets back.

## How the data was checked

The build script is public ([build.py](https://github.com/yasumorishima/kaggle-datasets/blob/main/savant-extras-dataset/build.py)) and runs on GitHub Actions. It publishes nothing unless every table passes: the seasons present are exactly the expected ones, each season has a minimum number of rows, **no two seasons of a table are the same table, or nearly the same** (most shared players with identical numbers, which catches a season answered with another season's table that Savant has since revised a little), `pitch_movement` has FF, SI, FC, SL, ST, CU, CH and FS in every season, and every CSV of the previous version has a successor.

## How This Data Was Collected

```python
pip install savant-extras

from savant_extras import catcher_stance, pitch_movement, park_factors
df = catcher_stance(2026)                   # one row per catcher
sl = pitch_movement(2026, pitch_type="SL")  # one pitch type per request
pf = park_factors(2026)                     # Statcast park factors, 30 clubs
```

Data from [Baseball Savant](https://baseballsavant.mlb.com/) (MLB Advanced Media), and [FanGraphs](https://www.fangraphs.com/) for `pitcher_quality`. Regular seasons 2024, 2025 and 2026.
